Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
Short Description
Our IT department at Schaeffler is currently searching for a seasoned ServiceNow Senior Developer.
This role is pivotal in linking IT and business requirements, aiming to deliver the best possible solutions across our organization. The primary duty of the ServiceNow Developer will be to comprehend business procedures, pinpoint areas for enhancement, and cater to these needs by closely collaborating with our IT team and other key players.
This position holds immense significance in delivering high-grade IT solutions to every Schaeffler employee.
 Your Key Responsibilities
 Lead the design, development, configuration, and customization of ServiceNow applications, modules, and solutions, aligning with business and strategic goals.
 Oversee and execute end-to-end implementation of key ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, SPM, and other ServiceNow out of box modules.
 Foster a culture of continuous improvement and teamwork within a large DevOps environment, promoting knowledge sharing and professional development.
 Collaborate closely with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, ensuring alignment with best practices.
 Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using APIs, MID servers, and other integration methods.
 Support architecture team to perform platform upgrades, patches, and maintenance, ensuring proactive risk management and minimal business disruption.
 Design, develop, and enforce automated testing frameworks (such as ATF) to enhance solution reliability, productivity, and accuracy.
 Create and maintain detailed technical documentation, process flows, user guides, and knowledge base articles.
 Ensure all solutions comply with security, data protection, and compliance requirements.
 Advocate for the strategic use of ServiceNow to drive business automation, operational efficiency, and high-quality user experiences.
 Your Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree is a plus.
 2+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, with proven experience in complex, enterprise-scale environments.
 Proficiency in JavaScript, API, ServiceNow scripting, and advanced platform components.
 Deep knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture, core applications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, etc.), and system integrations.
 Demonstrated experience developing and implementing robust integration solutions with third-party systems (REST/SOAP, JDBC, etc.).
 ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CSA, CAD) highly desired.
 Thorough understanding of ITIL, service management concepts, and DevOps methodologies.
 Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills for difficult platform issues.
 Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple requirements in parallel.
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments preferred.
 Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable with both independent and collaborative work.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you;
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind;
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.;
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library;
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best;
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and thorough referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow;
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday;
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we’re committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us;
Meal Tickets: we’re happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable;
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
